verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer programmatic access, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no API at all, and no scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents. The PBS account's shared staff payment access is a human account-sharing feature, not agent API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
